claims.claim: Citation expansion benefits depend on retriever and query construction; the paper does not establish universal benefit.
Method, background and result relevance are separately annotated and differ from topical similarity.
Query2doc has mixed cross-domain effects and preserving original-query information matters.
Legacy APIs require a single connection and no more than one request every three seconds; manual recommends caching identical daily queries.
Official endpoint and dictionary use different post/tweet field naming; live compatibility is unresolved.
Explicit facet lanes and bounded identity pooling are the smallest useful next experiment before a new semantic index or generated expansion.
Seven discovery attempts produced six complete captures and 59 raw leads; one lane reached its time limit. This is not a semantic-quality or uptime measurement.

For the frozen 56-work pool, compact packets selected 15 versus 2 works at 64 KiB and 42 versus 29 at 128 KiB, preserving selected text and reconstructable provenance. This does not establish improved semantic ranking.
